summary: A pi-family channel's driver log keeps a separate 10 s limit for outage notes and other failure notes, so an error from a stopping daemon no longer hides the 'may be restarting' note that follows it (#4733)

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: Only which lines a pi-family channel writes to its driver log changes; at most one outage note and one failure note per 10 s. No wire, client or CLI output change.
